items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh, you mentioned George Field, who did he play with? ... I think George was playing with only Robichaud I think.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. You don't remember the first thing you started on guitar?
They were on my guitar there. All the hands, but then they were on the guitar. All hands. All hands. Oh, you mentioned George Field, who did he play with?
Well, I don't remember who George played, but I know that George was one of them good
